type: Targeted reliability follow-up selected on prior content errors; not an independent benchmark.
selection: Distinct cases with incorrect completed GPT-labelled answers in the frozen new-input study. Excludes the interrupted UTC request.
ordering: Each repetition contains all four cases in both arms; shuffle eight requests within each repetition.
prompt_policy: Exact original frozen strings. No new candidate generation, instruction edits, output repair, or grader changes.
billing_plan: Read key-specific used-quota counter before and after this execution; inspect only read-only billing metadata/logs. Publish study deltas or matching per-request charges, not names, keys, balances or unrelated account history. Account for shared-key activity and settlement uncertainty.
limitations: Four selected known failure cases, not twenty independent tasks per arm.
Five stochastic repetitions do not establish general reliability or causal semantic equivalence.
Model identity and gateway accounting are unverified.
Prior benchmark and follow-up scores remain separate and unchanged.
Interval billing counters may include external activity on the same key; exact attribution requires matching request IDs.
